# 【CASTLEVANIA: SYMPHONY OF THE NIGHT】what is a demon dog 🐾 【FUWAMOCO｜悪魔城ドラキュラX 月下の夜想曲】

## ⚡ Quick Stream Highlights (TL;DR)
- FUWAMOCO navigated the challenging Castlevania: Symphony of the Night, battling persistent technical issues with their original PS1 disc and PS2 console.
- The duo humorously struggled with complex game mechanics, low HP, and bizarre in-game logic, leading to self-deprecating remarks and comedic moments.
- Key in-game discoveries included strategic item usage for boss battles, new movement abilities like the double leap, and unexpected healing mechanics with poison and ice cream.
- Beyond gameplay, FUWAMOCO announced an upcoming official Hololive appearance for Holocure and shared insights into their retro computing interests, including the PC98 and physical CD collection.

## ⭐ Standout Stories & Timestamps
- **[⏱️ 00:19:54](#t=00:19:54) Holy Water Loss Panic**: FUWAMOCO expresses distress over losing a crucial item: 'I lost my holy water at some point. No, I can't. I lost my holy water!'
- **[⏱️ 00:46:11](#t=00:46:11) Ambushed by a 'Cute' Ghost**: FUWAMOCO expresses disbelief and humor after being stabbed by an in-game ghost they found 'cute', leading to a significant loss of HP.
- **[⏱️ 01:19:15](#t=01:19:15) Holy Water Boss Strategy**: Excited reactions as the holy water strategy proves highly effective against the boss, 'Boss Rafas'.
- **[⏱️ 01:26:55](#t=01:26:55) Discovering Double Leap**: FUWAMOCO expresses excitement and wonder upon discovering a 'double leap' ability, envisioning new possibilities.
- **[⏱️ 02:04:36](#t=02:04:36) Vampires and Water**: Confusion arises about game mechanics as FUWAMOCO wonders, 'I'm going to drown. I'm going to drown. I don't think we're drowning. I think it's just because there's a merman in the little pile of water... Vampires can swim. I think water hurts you.'
- **[⏱️ 02:29:00](#t=02:29:00) Poison Heals with Topas**: FUWAMOCO succinctly summarizes the counter-intuitive effect of 'Topas' an item that restores HP from poison damage: 'If you get poison, you heal.'
- **[⏱️ 03:04:36](#t=03:04:36) Ice Cream Logic Explained**: FUWAMOCO provides a comical justification for an item's negative effect: 'Anybody eating the ice cream is going to drop defense, right? Like ice cream. Your defense drops instead of having ice cream. Yeah, you're so focused on the ice cream. You're just thinking happy things. You're not thinking about how somebody's going to come up and attack you.'
- **[⏱️ 03:22:30](#t=03:22:30) Official Hololive Channel Appearance for Holocure**: FUWAMOCO reveals an upcoming special program on the official Hololive channel, related to the game Holocure, strongly encouraging viewers to pre-register for bonuses.

The speaker expresses a deep respect for the PC98, viewing its acquisition as a significant commitment requiring prior knowledge, similar to owning a pet. They decide to collect games first in preparation. Later, the speaker reminisces about seeing Elizabeth Rose Bloodflame (Gigi Murin) playing RollerCoaster Tycoon and recalls a memorable, funny sound Gigi made. The discussion then transitions to Castlevania: Symphony of the Night, with detailed talk about game mechanics, character forms like the wolf, grinding for levels, and even specific spell inputs, concluding with a reading of iconic Castlevania quotes from chat.
